mutants.name: MUTANT_STALE_GENERATION
mutants.removes: a superseded attempt publishing an accepted verdict
mutants.counterexample: E       Failed: DID NOT RAISE ConflictError
mutants.note: the test failed against the mutated core, as it must

mutants.name: MUTANT_MISSING_CHECK
mutants.removes: acceptance with one required check absent
mutants.counterexample: E       AssertionError: acceptance succeeded with lint absent; absent evidence is never success
mutants.note: the test failed against the mutated core, as it must

digest_normalization: Digests are sha256 over the file's bytes with CRLF folded to LF, which is the form git stores and the form a POSIX checkout reads. A line-ending-only change does not alter the digest.
scope: A CAUGHT result means one named guard in tasks.py was removed and one named test failed against the mutated copy, on this host, at the digest above. It does not establish that the guard is the only way to break the rule, and it establishes nothing about any other module.
